item.description:
Release v5.1.2

Changes since v5.1.1

  • feat(AppUpdatePlugin): add plugin with Sparkle-based update checking
  • feat(HostSettingsPlugin): integrate AppUpdatePlugin for check updates in About view
  • feat(IdleTimePlugin): add open data directory button and fix build
  • feat(LumiKernel): add CommandMenuPlacement for per-group menu positioning
  • feat(MenuBarManagerPlugin): use UpdateService directly and extract view files
  • feat(settings): create AppSettingsPlugin for General and Appearance tabs
  • feat(settings): move About page from HostSettingsPlugin to AppUpdatePlugin
  • refactor: move AppCommands.swift to Bootstrap directory
  • refactor: move DebugCommand from LumiFactory to CommandPlugin
  • refactor(LumiFactory): move update checking to AppUpdatePlugin
  • refactor(LumiFactory): render plugin commands as Views inside CommandGroup
  • refactor(settings): update PluginService to use AppSettingsPlugin
